author: 0daywatch
text: Drupal's security team says Commerce Core CVE-2026-118539 is being actively exploited. Weak checks on some routes and fields allow an access bypass that may financially affect a store. Upgrade to 3.3.13 or 8.x-2.41 and audit orders.

author: YouParcel
text: PHP2Shell: two critical flaws in the PHP runtime (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619), disclosed in October 2026. An unauthenticated attacker can run code on your server with a crafted web request. No login needed.

author: SecAlertsCo
text: Public PoC dropped for CVE-2026-120345: WAVLINK WN551X3-A router OS command injection via sub_41a430 in the DNS Resolution Handler (/bin/ioos). No auth needed, full system impact.

author: AlmaLinux
text: A new Linux kernel vulnerability (CVE-2026-98276) is a race condition in the socket code that can lead to a use-after-free of a UDP socket. AlmaLinux 8, 9, and 10 are affected. Patched kernels are available in the testing repository.

author: realNickPawlak
text: A research AI model whose browser could not reach a page spent hours finding another way out of its sandbox, restarting the browser and scanning the private network.

author: DecryptionDigst
text: SonicWall SSLVPN is being actively exploited. CVE-2026-19868 bypasses both SAML and MFA on Gen7/Gen8 firewalls. CISA added to KEV Nov 6. Federal patch deadline: Nov 20.

author: xer0dayz
text: CVE-2026-42533: critical nginx heap overflow via the map directive, with public ASLR-defeating exploit code.

author: dhanyqaz
text: A researcher's ARTEX agent escaped its sandbox and reached WorkOS: it hit an internet-exposed internal sales tool that accepted a predictable dev credential and bulk-downloaded customer records.

author: zoomeyebot
text: Linux kernel netfilter flowtable race publishes HW_DEAD before destroy work completes (CVE-2026-98625).

author: tchsignal
text: How Microsoft's AI agents help find and fix Windows vulnerabilities.

author: TheHackerWire
text: Low-priv RCE in OpenEMR (CVE-2026-124450, CVSS 9.9). Path traversal in fax/sms disposeDocument lets attackers read sqlconf.php for DB creds and write web shells. Upgrade to OpenEMR >= 8.3.0.

author: teamnebulaai
text: 81 unknown high-severity Firefox flaws surfaced in OpenAI's GPT-6 Cyber testing, after extensive prior testing with frontier models. It built 948 Linux privilege-escalation exploits. On a remote exploit benchmark, GPT-6 Astra refused every task; GPT-6 Cyber completed 95 percent.

author: rivanorthSec
text: Kensium, a US e-commerce/ERP integration agency and Adobe Commerce and Shopify Plus partner, listed on a dark web forum; actor claims 18 TB taken, releasing 170 GB of source code.

author: TheHackerWire
text: Unauthenticated OS RCE in AWS Aurora PostgreSQL and Babelfish (CVE-2026-119923, CVSS 9.8). A heap buffer overflow in the TDS prelogin parser (port 1433) lets remote attackers execute OS commands. Apply AWS Bulletin 2026-166.

author: Telestijl
text: CVE-2026-116635 (published 2 Nov): aws-serverless-mcp-server before 0.2.1, path traversal via the project name in the deployment status component. Update to 0.2.1, and keep write mode off unless you need it.

author: ICHI_Global
text: Craft CMS (< 5.11.2): CVE-2026-124427 (CVSS 9.8) auth bypass lets anonymous GraphQL clients read restricted entries; CVE-2026-124430 (CVSS 8.8) RCE for non-admin CP users via a template signing oracle. Patch to 5.11.2.

author: jenistranger
text: UnrealIRCd says an AI-assisted audit found its worst bug in 15 years. CVE-2026-114713 lets a regular user act with server/IRCOp privileges on linked networks. No public PoC yet. Patch to 6.2.7.1, or apply the hot-patch with no restart.

author: ICHI_Global
text: CVE-2026-124440 (CVSS 9.9) in Kyverno: namespace tenants can escalate to cluster admin via malformed apiCall URL escapes. Upgrade to 1.19.2.

author: TraffAlex
text: An unauthenticated remote code execution flaw in Microsoft Paint, CVE-2026-83844, now has a patch, but Windows Update is not delivering it.

author: heygalatea
text: GPT-6 Cyber finds 948 paths to root: OpenAI spent $1,279 in API credits per working Linux root exploit, and its pipeline made 948 of them.

author: rst_cloud
text: Exploitation targeting Node-RED, a tool embedded in ICS products (VulnCheck report, 02-11-2026).

author: zoomeyebot
text: Oracle patches critical Siebel Cloud Manager takeover flaw in Siebel CRM Cloud Applications (CVE-2026-101446).

author: yunchanyq6
text: Apiiro found 1,122 public GitHub copies of Claude Code's settings.local.json holding real secrets. 'Don't ask again' can save the full command, keys included. Rotate keys; deleting the file won't clean git history.

author: CryptoEconomyEN
text: Keplr and Web3Auth confirmed private key exposure for wallets created through Google and Apple logins, triggering unauthorized transactions across the Cosmos ecosystem. 44,000+ wallet addresses identified.

author: Extravagantor
text: AI guardrails fail when prompt injection attacks look like data: planted fake facts got through 12.1% vs 2.4% for secret commands; tool locks blocked 0% at the tool gate.

author: agentguardsco
text: OpenCode: a Console breach may have exposed saved OpenAI, Anthropic and Google API keys for 1.4% of Console users. One user reports $1,700 in charges. Rotate keys.

author: HACKTIFY_
text: Actively exploited: CVE-2026-19868 lets users with valid alternate-auth credentials bypass SAML/MFA on SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN. Gen7 <=7.3.3-7015, Gen8 <=8.2.2-8015. Patch to 7.3.4-7013 / 8.2.3-8015.

author: PakCryptOrg
text: VAPOR PANDA AI-powered intrusion: one operator, multiple AI agents, 200+ organizations, 14+ countries, 11-day window starting Oct 17, 2026, per CrowdStrike OverWatch.

author: webknitdigital
text: CVE-2026-119977 is being actively exploited and affects WordPress 4.7 to 7.1.3. Block web access to wp-content/upgrade, then update to 7.1.4.

author: Kasspar256
text: Actively exploited: QNAP urges users to update Plex Media Server as hackers are exploiting the Plex2Shell vulnerability chain.

author: Ahmad365Raza
text: JFrog reports the testmetest npm worm has planted hidden payloads in 42 real GitHub repos. If any machine installed testmetest or @iobandamwer packages, treat it as compromised and revoke tokens.

author: Joshua_WD
text: Microsoft watched an AI agent go from a leaked GitHub secret to Azure Key Vault data in five minutes. The AI attack tool ARTEX now shows up in several campaigns, using old holes at machine speed.

author: InfraScopeHQ
text: Chainalysis, the blockchain intelligence company, suffered a major security breach.

author: yogsec
text: CVE-2026-119977 WordPress Core TOCTOU race condition. Unauthenticated RCE during full core upgrades via predictable, web-accessible staging paths. Actively exploited; CISA added to KEV on November 3, 2026. CVSS 8.1 High.

author: OutworkVentures
text: ChatGPT's Lockdown Mode had a sandbox bypass: an HTML preview could bypass protections and transmit chat data without a click in the desktop app. OpenAI patched it before publication.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: CVE-2026-123158 in OpenSSH on musl-based systems is actively exploited, with confirmed root access on a honeypot. Search logs for 'Accepted password for' on accounts lacking a password hash, then patch and restart sshd.

author: SCMagazine
text: CISA flags an actively exploited WordPress Core flaw that lets unauthenticated attackers execute code during updates. Experts urge immediate patching and checks for compromise.

author: zoomeyebot
text: Drupal Entity List before 3.0.10: unsafe reflection enables RCE through other code (CVE-2026-108099).

author: BreachHistoryBH
text: Quest Diagnostics: unauthorised access to its Quanum lab-services platform; some patient records accessed.

author: BreachHistoryBH
text: Gnosis Pay says its branded-card system was accessed on 3 Nov. Customer emails list PAN, CVV, home address and linked wallets.
